reviews.name: Damon Lister
reviews.quote: Wonderful experience at Clearwater Dentist this morning! Staff was amazing, really happy with the services provided.

reviews.name: Maya
reviews.quote: Extremely pleasant experience with everyone at Clearwater Dentist! Very thorough exam and a friendly staff. I would absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a dentist that cares.

reviews.name: Bobby Marco
reviews.quote: Can't stress how great this place is! The staff are super accommodating and friendly. Was in and out with no issues. Easily the best dentist I've been to and I would absolutely recommend them to anyone!

reviews.name: Stella Marco
reviews.quote: New patient since Dec 2025. I can't say enough about Dr Nadia & her staff. Dr Nadia is an expert in her field of dentistry and more. Her office is a one-stop shop for quality care.

reviews.name: Starlet Boesch
reviews.quote: Just did xerf and overall very pleased.

reviews.name: Jonathan Hampton
reviews.quote: Super friendly and make u feel right at home.

reviews.name: Robin Scherer
reviews.quote: Amazing dentist. Best dental cleaning that I've had in my entire life — great service, they threw in a toothbrush at no extra charge, and they're going to help me with Invisalign when three other dentists said I wasn't eligible.

reviews.name: cyrus hornsby
reviews.quote: Very thorough cleaning. Not rough at all. Teeth felt very clean for 6 months. Martha was wonderful.

reviews.name: Yannis Talbi
reviews.quote: Great team and great doctor. If you want somebody really caring about you this is the place you want to go to. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Michelle Thorson
reviews.quote: Great office team and Martha was an exceptional hygienist! Overall a very positive experience and an extra plus — it ended with a pup coming in with the dentist for the final check. Thank you Martha and team!

reviews.name: chris primeau
reviews.quote: After 50+ years of dental work, this was honestly one of the best experiences I've ever had. Dr. Nadia and the high-tech approach made my visit comfortable and pain-free.

reviews.name: Adrian E. Holmes
reviews.quote: Clearwater Dentist is a real dentist's office — a true full-service practice. They don't sugar coat what you need. Amazing cleaning, whitening, and in-house financing payment plans.

reviews.name: Sterling Fields
reviews.quote: All the staff was wonderful. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Kristina G
reviews.quote: I don't usually write reviews, but I had such a great experience at this dental office that I felt I had to share it. From the moment I walked in, the team at the front desk was very welcoming and friendly.

reviews.name: Hannah Warner
reviews.quote: Everyone here is lovely! Martha did my cleaning and she was amazing. Overall a very nice and comfortable experience. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.name: Dmytro Kyrychenko
reviews.quote: The best clinic that keeps up with all the latest technologies. They are true professionals. I recommend them 100%.

reviews.name: Erika McGrath
reviews.quote: Fantastic personalized experience! Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Meghan McDuff
reviews.quote: As someone who is terrified of anything medically oriented and has a low pain tolerance, I can't say enough positive remarks about my experience. From start to finish, the entire team was kind, patient, and personable.

reviews.name: Cody Cook
reviews.quote: I have been to plenty of dentistries over the years, and this is by far the best dentistry I have ever been to. The entire staff is super friendly, the prices are reasonable, and they all do a fantastic job.

reviews.name: Edgardo "Eddie Oaks" Ocasio
reviews.quote: Always a great experience! And I feel the dentists here take pride in their work and it shows.

reviews.name: N T
reviews.quote: I got a great cleaning today at Clearwater Dentist. Martha did her job so good. Her manners are good. She really takes care of the patient. And doctor Nadezhda listened very carefully to all my concerns.

reviews.name: Roman
reviews.quote: Great clinic! The people who work here are true professionals. They explain everything, do their work carefully and are very attentive to patients. Highly recommend!
